annotations.title: Post-earnings drift (PEAD): stocks moving after earnings

description: Which stocks are drifting after earnings right now? Returns the Regime Card post-earnings drift (PEAD) tracker: large US stocks that reported earnings in about the last two weeks, in the tracker's own order, each with its report date, its earnings surprise, its first-session reaction and its price drift since the report. $0.02 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Rescanned each morning before the US open; prices refresh in rotation while the US market is open. "stale" is true until the current session's rescan has completed. Useful when an agent needs an earnings surprise check, post-earnings announcement drift data or an earnings calendar follow-up for stocks.
name: earnings_drift

asOf.description: The day of the tracker's newest scan (YYYY-MM-DD).

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

record.description: The public, hash-linked record of the daily settled regime reading: its percentile and its regime label. It covers nothing else in this response: not the stress gate, stock or coin figures, the scorecard, or a live intraday reading. The same on every response.

covers.description: The reading it covers: the percentile and the regime label of each daily settled reading, and nothing else in this response.

ledger.description: Every entry as JSON, each with the hash of the entry before it.

note.const: Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
note.description: The same facts in one plain sentence.

verify.description: The page that explains the hash chain and checks every entry in the browser.

related.description: The other paid routes: for each, its path, the question it answers and its price per call. Each is a separate call.

path.description: The route's path on this origin.

per.description: What the price is for: one call, or each covered symbol of one call.

priceUsd.description: The price in US dollars, paid in USDC.

research.description: A published Regime Card study of the current regime. Present only when one exists for it.

stale.description: True while the morning rescan of the current session has not completed: it did not run, or it is still adding stocks, so the list can gain names and ranks can move.

status.description: "live": the US stock market is open right now (market holidays and half days counted) and the newest price refresh in the list is at most 20 minutes old. "settled": at any other time, the newest scan's list with the last prices it has.

stocks.description: The stocks in their post-earnings window, in the tracker's own order. Facts about each report and the price move since. The order's formula stays private.

daysSinceReport.description: Calendar days from the report to asOf.

driftPct.description: The move since the report: the latest price against the last close before the report, in percent.

driftVsDailyRange.description: driftPct as a multiple of the stock's average daily range before the report.

epsSurprisePct.description: Reported earnings per share against the analyst estimate, in percent of the estimate.

pricedAt.description: When this stock's price was last refreshed (UTC): the time of the refresh, and the price source can run about 15 minutes behind the market. Prices refresh a few at a time, in rotation, while the US market is open, so this can be well before updatedAt. A refresh outside a session is given as the close before it, which on a market holiday is before that day's scan. Null when the price is the last daily close the scan read.

rank.description: Its place in the tracker's own order, 1 first.

reactionPct.description: The first session after the report: its close against the last close before the report, in percent.

reportDate.description: The day the company reported earnings (YYYY-MM-DD).

reportTime.description: Whether it reported before the US open or after the close. Null when not known.

sinceReactionPct.description: The move after the first session: the latest price against that session's close, in percent.

updatedAt.description: The later of the scan's completion and the newest price in the list (UTC). One stock's own price time is its pricedAt.

title: Post-earnings drift (PEAD): stocks moving after earnings
